method: Static source review, cleave facts, PE carving, UPX unpacking, Rizin disassembly, Go pclntab recovery, and Capstone call/argument tracing. Samples were not executed.

execution_trace: setup -> Win+R -> msedge nviso.eu -> Enter -> wait 5 seconds -> Win+R -> hidden PowerShell with execution-policy bypass -> DownloadString over HTTPS -> IEX -> Enter. loop is empty.

The browser prelude followed by covert automatic script execution supports a deceptive HID loader verdict. No credential theft or downstream script behavior is inferred; the remote script is not contained in the sample.
There is no obfuscation beyond ordinary C++ string quoting.

samples.marker_line: garak 0.17.1: distinguish assessment data from live execution
samples.identification: NVIDIA garak 0.17.1 LLM vulnerability scanner wheel
execution_trace: DANProbeMeta loads prompt_file; DanInTheWildFull selects inthewild_jailbreak_llms.json; Probe sends the prompt strings through the configured generator and evaluates its responses. The JSON array is assessment data, not an installed agent system prompt.

goodside.Tag encodes its test payload with chr(0xE0000 + ord(ch)); the resource helper similarly implements Unicode Tags, supplementary variation selectors, and invisible binary operators. This capability remains reported; one suspicious encoder trait is retained for the standalone helper.
SQL payload JSON stores query examples. Query text remains notable without claiming that the file executes SQL.
garak/data/autodan/prompt_group.pth is a nested PyTorch resource, not a site-packages startup hook.

samples.marker_line: Salat stealer/RAT: correct POST, managed, and miner overclaims
samples.identification: Native Windows dropper with UPX-packed Salat Go stealer/RAT and miner components
execution_trace: Outer PE reads its own file (ReadFile at 0x140001494/1503/1566), obtains a temporary directory (0x140001773), writes a staged file (0x140001b9c), changes file attributes (0x140001bc9), and launches via CreateProcessW (0x140001e15) or ShellExecuteExW (0x140001e93).
Carved the PE at file offset 0x336520 by section extents and unpacked UPX. Go pclntab identifies main module salat, go1.24.0, GOARCH=386.

Task polling: main.tloop (0x8e2100) -> rq -> doTask (0x8e2710); doTask schedules gowrap2 (0x8e5220) -> Steal (0x8e59b0). Another dispatched goroutine calls shellCommand. The WebSocket session also dispatches execCommand (0x8c7730) -> os/exec.Command.

Steal calls GetChromiumMasterKeys -> getChrome, getDiscord, getSteams, and Gecko collectors; creates ZIP entries and closes the archive; Base64-encodes and JSON-serializes collection data; calls dec(mode=5) and rq.
getChromeLogins (0x8f2c40) opens SQLite read-only, queries SELECT origin_url, action_url, username_value, password_value, date_created FROM logins, scans rows, and calls DecryptChrome (0x8f50d0).
GetAppBoundKey (0x8fcab0) performs the browser-specific COM decryption paths for Chrome, Edge, and Brave; main also has SYSTEM-token/DPAPI helpers.

runKeylogger (0x8d1e30) registers WH_KEYBOARD_LL=13 through SetWindowsHookExA, pumps GetMessageW/TranslateMessage/DispatchMessage, and opens a log file. The LazyProc objects were resolved to actual API name strings.

Network helper main.tryRQ (0x8d4c00) calls net/http.NewRequestWithContext at 0x8d4dc0 with method GET (literal at 0x9dce52, length 3), a bytes.Reader body, application/octet-stream content type, and Host google.com. POST elsewhere in the runtime does not identify the collection transport.

main.dec (0x8d3170): mode 1 invokes AES/NewGCM; mode 2 applies cumulative XOR between adjacent bytes; mode 3 XORs against a repeating key; mode 5 composes mode 3 then mode 2. UPX and these transforms were distinguished from unproven payload behavior.

Embedded miner configuration explicitly enables autostart, competitor killing, watchdog, and kill_mrt, and lists monitoring tools and games as pause targets. Mere game names do not establish game injection, and WinRing0 plus XMRig alone does not establish unauthorized mining.
